entries.en: [Help So Mi rise] Gotta move on, c'mon.
entries.ro: [Ajută-o pe So Mi să se ridice] Hai, trebuie să ne mișcăm.

entries.en: A riddle wrapped in a mystery…
It's gotta, I know, So Mi. But you killed it. Saved our asses.
entries.ro: Trebuie să meargă, știu, So Mi. Dar ai făcut-o bine. Ne-ai salvat pielea.

entries.en: Watch my comfort zone, keep it clear.
As long as it fuckin' takes. You have a job, focus on that.
entries.ro: Cât o fi nevoie, dracu' s-o ia. Ai treabă, fii cu mintea la ea.

entries.en: [Link up] On your lonesome? Kill us both.
Too weak to handle it on your lonesome. Need my help, or we both die here!
entries.en_m: You're too weak to handle it on your lonesome. Need my help, or we both die here!
entries.ro: Ești prea slabă ca să te descurci singură. Ai nevoie de mine, altfel murim amândoi aici!
entries.ro_m: Ești prea slab ca să te descurci singur. Ai nevoie de mine, altfel murim amândoi aici!

entries.en: Neural bridge, let's go! I'll be your back-up.
entries.ro: Punte neurală, hai! Te acopăr eu.
Lasă-mă să te ajut. Sprijină-te de mine.

entries.en: I'll fire up the control panel, bring the train in.
entries.ro: Pornesc panoul de control, aduc trenul.

entries.en: How is it?! Any minute now?
Done and done. Train's on the way!
entries.ro: Gata, gata. Trenul e pe drum!

entries.en: Had a little luck. Can't last long.
entries.ro: Am avut puțin noroc. Nu ține mult.

entries.en: We're fucked, you know! I have to drop past the Wall, no other way.
entries.ro: Ne-am futut, știi! Trebuie să trec dincolo de Blackwall, n-am altă cale.

entries.en: All units – Idaho Vermont. That's Idaho Vermont.
entries.ro: Toate unitățile – Idaho Vermont. Repet: Idaho Vermont.

entries.en: 'Member, train's prolly got a service subnet.
entries.ro: Ține minte, trenul are probabil un subnet de service.

entries.en: Subnet, there's likely to be one.
It's bound to be slower by eons…
entries.ro: O să fie cu eoni mai lent...

entries.en: Not suggesting you use it, suggesting you gate it off.
entries.en_m: Not suggestin' you use it, suggestin' you gate it off.
entries.ro: Nu zic să-l folosești, zic să-l izolezi.

entries.en: Outflanking maneuver? Possible. I'll drop an ICE-drape on the junction.
entries.ro: Manevră de flancare? Posibil. Pun o plasă de ICE pe joncțiune.

entries.en: Likely no joyride ahead, but… link up, do it!
entries.en_m: Likely no joyride ahead… But link up, do it!
entries.ro: Probabil n-o să fie nicio plimbare, dar... conectează-te, hai!

entries.en: Ugh… uhhh. V? Run for cover! In here, quick!
entries.ro: Ugh... ăă. V? Fugi la adăpost! Aici, repede!

entries.en: It's the Blackwall. No fear, Song. Right here with you.
entries.ro: E Blackwall. Nu-ți fie frică, Song. Sunt aici, cu tine.
